correctness.rationale: For every odd prime p the fiber-matched Fourier minor nonvanishing theorem of Loukaki and a parity flip in the column set prove all mixed/mixed 3x3 minors nonsingular. With pure-parity rows, Chebotarev nonsingularity of prime-order minors proves determinant nonzero for three distinct column prime indices; two colliding indices produce exactly two proportional columns and the remaining prime 2x2 minor has rank two. Transposition finishes the iff and exact nullity. Pure triples count A=2*binom(p,3), colliding triples B=2p(p-1), disjoint, hence 2AB. A mixed frequency triple admitting three zeros would need a singular 3x3 minor whose one-dimensional right kernel has a zero coordinate, contradicting exactly 3 nonzero spectral coefficients; a parity-pure triple gives 0,2,4 zeros via Chebotarev. Exact two-frequency zero count gcd(d,2p) belongs to {1,2,p}; four-frequency cubic P(z)=(z-1)(z-omega)(z-omega^2) gives exactly 3 zeros and four nonzero coefficients for p>=5. Replayed an independent integer-cyclotomic exhaustive determinant classifier at p=3,5,7, obtaining counts 48/400,1600/14400,11760/132496. Those finite tests corroborate but do not prove every prime; the named theorems and symbolic case reasoning do.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge new iff rank-two defect classification and all-p count for 2p Fourier minors, together with three-frequency zero-spectrum and exact-support gap. Loukaki Theorem A is a one-direction matched-fiber sufficient nonvanishing theorem, not a classification of all mixed and unmixed 3x3 determinants. Bonami–Ghobber address conventional at-most-support uncertainty equality; Krahmer–Pfander–Rashkov cover a finite order-six census; Caragea–Lee treat principal minors rather than arbitrary pairs. No verified stronger theorem or all-p table logically forces the complete statement as an already recorded result. It uses older lemmas but exact new structural consequences are not simply a renaming.
residual_risks: Older sparse-interpolation/coding-theory statements may give the exact 2p three-zero forbidden gap without being discoverable under Fourier-minor language.
Loukaki theorem and prime Chebotarev are essential established ingredients; no new general nonvanishing theorem for arbitrary sizes is asserted.
Only p=3,5,7 were exhaustively enumerated computationally.

value.rationale: A complete and exact singular-minor rank classification for an infinite square-free family isolates all interpolation failures and their multiplicities; the surprising unattainability of exactly 3 zeros for a three-frequency signal gives a sharp exact-support uncertainty gap. This is a natural harmonic-analysis object with a reusable deterministic obstruction, not just redoing small-prime matrix counts.
